## What's Changed
### ⚠️ Compatibility Notes
* Note text that looks like an application frame in user and tool content instead of escaping it by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11813
* Add `OutputTokenLimitExceeded`, and fall back to the next model in `ModelFallback` when a response is cut off at `max_tokens` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12407
* Ask for approvals and answers inside the run with `RequestInput`, put `AskUser` on the deferred pipeline, and mark deferred calls with `kind` and `answered_by` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12757
* Add `DelegationTasks.discover()` and stop one damaged saved task from blocking `DelegationTasks.opened()` by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10140
* Require workspace backends to leave detached processes running, and check it in `WorkspaceBackendSuite` by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/13070
* Run `PromptInjectionDefender` semantic classification as durable operations so it works on
